payload.tension: The passage states matthew 4:1–3 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is locally described; the wording centers attention on “Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
